system.description: Your shapeshifting abilities are far more refined than the average bactosapien. You now gain expertise in Deception and Stealth to pretend to be an object or other humanoid, as the sheen and discolorations are now under thorough control. In addition, you may gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.yav7747ibqje7nzm]{Alter Self} spell whenever you use your @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-heritage-features.Item.II88nLCGjzX7H7Bl]{Shapeshifting} ability. Finally, you may now shapeshift for a total of 8 hours per long rest.
